_about: Read by delegate.py, check_setup.py and bench.py. Two harnesses: agy (Google Antigravity CLI) and codex (OpenAI Codex CLI, ChatGPT plan). A worker is agy:<model> or codex:<model>[:<effort>].

codex_models._about: Known Codex models (the list your plan offers changes: see ~/.codex/models_cache.json). Any model id works in a chain; this list is for people.
codex_models.gpt-6-luna: fast and affordable, easier tasks: builder fallback, tester, scribe fallback
codex_models.gpt-6.1-sol: coding and everyday work: builderplus, reviewer fallback, writer, designer, scripter
codex_models.gpt-6-astra: complex coding: hardest builderplus pieces, debugger, security, balance
codex_models.gpt-6.2-sol / gpt-6.2-astra: newer, in the model cache 2026-11-17 but not in the user's picker: check before use

families._about: Model id prefix -> family. A tester or reviewer never runs on the family of the builder it checks (delegate.py --after).

default_models._about: Used when a role file has no models: line.
